name: manage-swap
description: CFEngine Build module which manages a swap file: creates it, enables it, adds it to /etc/fstab and reports swap files as inventory.

manage-swap.description: Ensure a swap file of the configured size (default 2 GB) exists, is active and is persisted in /etc/fstab. Reports active swap files and total swap size as inventory.

input.label: Swap size (GB)
input.question: Size of the swap file in GB (e.g. '2' or '0.5')

input.label: Swap file path
input.question: Absolute path of the swap file
